beats.line: Ready for a ride that goes beyond the usual limits?
Facing unpredictable terrain? Or worried about your battery running out too soon?
Meet the KingSong 16S Electric Unicycle. Built to take you everywhere, dependably.
Its powerful 1200W rated motor conquers inclines up to 30 degrees effortlessly. And go up to 80 kilometres on a single charge.
The 16-inch wheel smooths out even the roughest Indian roads. Plus, enjoy your journey with built-in Bluetooth speakers.
Experience the KingSong 16S. Find yours at Radboards.in today.

caption: Navigate every street and conquer every incline with the KingSong 16S. ✨ Built for real Indian roads, its 16-inch wheel ensures a smooth glide. The 1200W motor tackles 30-degree inclines. Ride up to 80 km on a single charge! 🔋 Bluetooth speakers included. Get yours made to order. Shop Radboards.in. Range varies with rider, terrain, temp.
